paper_title: Evaluation is All You Need: Strategic Overclaiming of LLM Reasoning Capabilities Through Evaluation Design
reason: 이 논문은 평가 설정(N, 시드, 데이터셋 버전, 지시문 위치, GPQA 선택지 편향, Tensor Parallelism)에 따라 추론 모델의 점수가 얼마나 흔들리는지를 분석하는 연구다. 새로운 벤치마크를 만들거나 기존 벤치마크를 실질적으로 개정하지 않았다. 사용한 AIME24, AIME25, GPQA Diamond는 이미 인벤토리에 있거나 기존 공개 데이터셋이다. 논문이 제안하는 것은 평가 보고 원칙과 N 산정 절차이며 재사용 가능한 데이터셋이 아니다. 또한 논문이 직접 제공하는 공식 데이터셋·코드 링크가 없다. 따라서 추가하거나 수정할 행이 없다.

screening.paper_title: Evaluation is All You Need: Strategic Overclaiming of LLM Reasoning Capabilities Through Evaluation Design
screening.abstract: Reasoning models represented by the Deepseek-R1-Distill series have been widely adopted by the open-source community due to their strong performance in mathematics, science, programming, and other domains. However, our study reveals that their benchmark evaluation results are subject to significant fluctuations caused by various factors. Subtle differences in evaluation conditions can lead to substantial variations in results. Similar phenomena are observed in other open-source inference models fine-tuned based on the Deepseek-R1-Distill series, as well as in the QwQ-32B model, making their claimed performance improvements difficult to reproduce reliably. Therefore, we advocate for the establishment of a more rigorous paradigm for model performance evaluation and present our empirical assessments of the Deepseek-R1-Distill series models.
